parts.html: The K-06 standard model is a sleek solution for contemporary interiors that value a light color palette, clean lines, and a functional use of space. White solid-color fronts form a visually light furniture composition that harmoniously complements minimalist apartments and private homes.

The straight layout places all the main kitchen zones along one wall, leaving open space for a dining set and comfortable movement. This option is especially well suited to compact apartments, studios, and open-plan kitchen and living areas.

A distinctive feature of the K-06 model is the combination of two types of fronts. The upper cabinets have foil-wrapped fronts, while the lower ones are made of acrylic-faced MDF panels. The solid white finish unites the different materials into a cohesive composition.
The chipboard-based countertop complements the kitchen’s minimalist character and provides a work surface for everyday cooking. The carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard.

Despite its compact straight layout, the kitchen includes functional storage solutions. A cargo pull-out helps organize kitchen utensils and food, while built-in appliances maintain the visual unity of the interior.
For everyday comfort, the kitchen uses Muller Profi Line hinges with soft-close mechanisms and Muller Box Profi Line drawers. Furniture handles are included.
Hinges: Muller Profi Line with soft-close mechanisms
DUMSKAYA DESIGN makes custom white kitchens for apartments, studios, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-06 standard model can be adapted to the dimensions of a specific room by changing the arrangement of cabinets, built-in appliances, and storage systems to meet the client’s individual requirements.
We offer a full range of services for kitchen furniture design, material selection, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
At the client’s request, the kitchen can also be fitted with a sink, appliances, a range hood, and plumbing fixtures.
To order the K-06 kitchen or get a personalized price quote, contact DUMSKAYA DESIGN.
